name: ikano-testapp-root
description: Root management for ISO 20022 Test Platform

scripts.install:all: npm run install:root && npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.backend: cd backend && (venv\Scripts\python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host localhost --port 8000 || ./venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host localhost --port 8000)
scripts.frontend: set "CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true" && set "WDS_SOCKET_PORT=3000" && npm start --prefix frontend || CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true WDS_SOCKET_PORT=3000 npm start --prefix frontend
scripts.dev:all: echo 'Please run backend and frontend in separate terminals using npm run backend and npm run frontend'
